sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark (fill in the blanks, true/false, match the columns or one word).

questions.q: Fill in the blanks. (a) ________ is the process of searching for and obtaining applicants for jobs. (b) The full form of CCTV is ________.
True or False. (a) Training and development includes fire drills, food hygiene and first aid. (b) Preventive maintenance waits for machines to fail.
questions.answer: (a) True. (b) False: it is regular action to avoid breakdowns.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks. (a) The head of the hotel security department is the Chief ________ Officer. (b) The maintenance department is also called the ________ department.
Match Column A with Column B. A: (a) PPM (b) Guest profiling. B: (i) Keeping detailed guest data to detect suspicious people (ii) Regular preventive actions on machines (iii) Rating of employees.
True or False. (a) Performance appraisal decides training needs and promotion. (b) Gardens in hotels have no value for guests.
questions.answer: (a) True. (b) False: they beautify the hotel and give guests a place to relax.

sections.title: Very short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: Describe any two functions of the Sanitation department.
questions.answer: It keeps the hotel clean and promotes health. It treats and disposes of waste properly and looks after the gardens to beautify the hotel.

questions.q: Define recruitment.
questions.answer: Recruitment is the process of searching for and obtaining job applicants, finding qualified persons and encouraging them to apply, so the right people can be selected.

questions.q: What is performance appraisal?
questions.answer: It is the assessment of an employee's actual performance, behaviour and potential. It is used to decide training needs, promotions, pay incentives, retention or termination.

questions.q: Why is guest baggage checking important?
questions.answer: It helps detect explosives and dangerous articles. It protects the guests, staff and the hotel from terror threats.

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: Describe any three functions of the Sanitation department.
questions.answer: (i) It keeps the entire hotel clean to protect health. (ii) It ensures treatment and proper disposal of waste. (iii) It maintains gardens and the cleanliness of rooms with the housekeeping staff.

questions.q: Explain the three main functions of the maintenance department of a hotel.
questions.answer: (i) Property operations: running machinery, water treatment, boilers and lighting round the clock. (ii) Planned preventive maintenance: a yearly schedule to avoid costly breakdowns. (iii) Fire and life safety: fire pumps, alarms, generators and evacuation drills.

questions.q: Explain the role of the Human Resource department in a hotel (three points).
questions.answer: (i) HR planning and recruitment of the right people. (ii) Training and development for skills such as food hygiene and customer service. (iii) Welfare and performance appraisal to motivate and assess staff.

questions.q: Explain any three security measures taken by a hotel.
questions.answer: (i) Limit access points and monitor them with CCTV. (ii) Scan guest baggage and hotel supplies. (iii) Guest profiling, employee verification and key control.

questions.q: Explain the role of the finance and accounts department (three points).
questions.answer: (i) It tracks all revenue and expenditure. (ii) It maintains the ledger, accounts payable and receivable and pays salaries. (iii) It gives financial data to managers for decisions and prepares reports.

sections.title: Long answer questions. Answer in 80–120 words.

questions.q: Explain the role of the security department in a hotel, in six points.
questions.answer: (i) It protects guests, staff and the hotel property. (ii) It patrols, monitors CCTV and investigates. (iii) It controls external access through limited gates, barriers and patrols. (iv) It checks baggage and supplies and verifies employees and guests. (v) It controls internal access, key handling and lifts by card key. (vi) It issues ID cards, deals with unauthorised persons and coordinates with the district administration.

questions.q: Explain the functions of the Human Resource department, in six points.
questions.answer: (i) HR planning forecasts the number and type of staff needed. (ii) Recruitment and selection obtain applicants and choose the right ones. (iii) Training teaches skills such as fire drills, food hygiene, first aid and customer service. (iv) Development prepares employees for greater responsibility. (v) Welfare builds trust and supports staff in difficult times. (vi) Performance appraisal with the rating scale method decides promotion, incentives and retention.
